verdict.rationale: Stripe Atlas is a SaaS incorporation service, and such a service could plausibly offer a developer API, so this axis applies. The evidence pack documents only dashboard and application workflows: incorporation, EIN, 83(b) filings, equity and SAFEs. It shows no Atlas API reference, interactive explorer, or runnable examples; the OpenAPI probes all returned 404, and the Stripe-wide llms.txt is a host-platform artifact that earns no credit.
